definition_zh: 鸟舍；大型鸟笼；鸟类饲养场
definition_en: a large enclosure or building for keeping birds
core_image: 罩着网顶的大笼子，鸟在里面飞而不出
scene: 鹦鹉扑翅掠过网顶的影子。The zoo opened a walk-through aviary last spring.
sceneCN: 这里 aviary 指「鸟舍」（第 1 个义项：养鸟的大型圈舍）；句意：动物园去年春天开放了一座可步入式鸟舍。

senses.title: A large enclosure for birds
senses.definition: a big cage, enclosure, or building in which birds are kept
senses.definitionCN: 圈养鸟类的大型笼舍或建筑
senses.example: The flamingos moved to a new aviary by the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 火烈鸟迁入了湖边的新鸟舍。
senses.why: The Latin root is avis, bird: the place named for its dwellers.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根是 avis「鸟」：以住户为场所命名。

senses.title: A domestic bird house
senses.definition: a smaller outdoor cage kept by hobbyists for pet birds
senses.definitionCN: 爱好者在庭院饲养宠物鸟的较小笼舍
senses.example: He built a backyard aviary for his budgies.
senses.exampleCN: 他为虎皮鹦鹉搭了座后院鸟舍。
senses.why: Scale alone separates the hobby shed from the zoo hall.
senses.whyCN: 业余小棚与动物园大馆只是规模之别。

senses.title: A zoo exhibit for flying birds
senses.definition: a zoo building designed so birds can fly free inside
senses.definitionCN: 园内供鸟类自由飞翔的展区建筑
senses.example: The walk-through aviary lets visitors share the airspace.
senses.exampleCN: 可步入式鸟舍让游客与鸟共享同一片空气。
senses.why: Designers inverted the cage: the humans enter the birds' room.
senses.whyCN: 设计者把笼子倒了过来：人走进鸟的房间。

senses.title: A breeding establishment
senses.definition: a facility where birds are bred for conservation or sale
senses.definitionCN: 为保育或出售而繁育鸟类的场所
senses.example: The sanctuary's aviary raises endangered parrots.
senses.exampleCN: 保护区的鸟舍繁育濒危鹦鹉。
senses.why: Keeping became breeding as conservation grew.
senses.whyCN: 随着保育兴起，「养鸟」变成了「繁育鸟」。

senses.title: A quarantine aviary
senses.definition: an enclosure where imported birds are held for inspection
senses.definitionCN: 隔离检疫进口鸟类用的圈舍
senses.example: Imported finches spent a month in the quarantine aviary.
senses.exampleCN: 进口雀鸟在检疫鸟舍待了一个月。
senses.why: Enclosure plus oversight is the aviary idea turned official.
senses.whyCN: 圈舍加监管，正是鸟舍概念的正装版本。

senses.title: Figurative: a noisy gathering
senses.definition: a place or group compared to a cage of chattering birds
senses.definitionCN: 被比作满笼啁啾之鸟的场所或人群
senses.example: The press room was an aviary before the verdict.
senses.exampleCN: 宣判前，记者室像座嘈杂的鸟舍。
senses.why: The bird image carries noise and restless movement.
senses.whyCN: 鸟的意象自带聒噪与躁动。

senses.title: In hawking history, the mews house
senses.definition: in older usage, housing for hawks and other hunting birds
senses.definitionCN: 旧义指饲养鹰隼等猎禽的房舍
senses.example: The manor kept an aviary for the falconer's birds.
senses.exampleCN: 庄园为驯鹰师的猎禽专设鹰舍。
senses.why: Before zoos, keeping birds meant keeping hunting partners.
senses.whyCN: 动物园之前，养鸟即是养狩猎伙伴。

senses.title: In architecture, the bird-room of a house
senses.definition: a glazed room of a country house set aside for birds
senses.definitionCN: 乡间宅邸中专辟给鸟类的玻璃花房式房间
senses.example: The conservatory doubled as the family aviary.
senses.exampleCN: 那间暖房兼作全家的鸟室。
senses.why: Estate architecture folded the aviary into the house itself.
senses.whyCN: 庄园建筑把鸟舍折进了住宅本体。

intro.en: Aviary comes from Latin aviarium, a place for birds, from avis, bird, plus the place-ending -arium; English adopted the word in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: aviary 出自拉丁语 aviarium「养鸟之所」，由 avis（鸟）+ 表场所的后缀 -arium 构成；英语于 16 世纪采纳该词。

items.en: The bird-root is reconstructed as awi- or h₂ewis, the old word for bird.
items.cn: 「鸟」词根被重构为 awi-/h₂ewis，即古老的「鸟」词。

items.en: avis meant bird and seeded a whole family: avian, aviation, aviator.
items.cn: avis 意为鸟，衍生出一整个词族：avian、aviation、aviator。

items.en: Romans kept aviaria for songbirds and doves in villas and temples.
items.cn: 罗马人在别墅与神庙设 aviaria 饲养鸣禽与鸽。

items.en: The neuter aviarium passed into Romance forms of the bird-place.
items.cn: 中性名词 aviarium 进入罗曼语族的「鸟舍」一词。

items.en: English borrowed aviary in the 1570s-80s for cages and bird-rooms.
items.cn: 英语在 1570 至 1580 年代借入 aviary，指鸟笼与鸟室。

items.en: The great walk-through aviaries of zoos redefined the word in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
items.cn: 19、20 世纪动物园的大型步入式鸟舍重新定义了这个词。

note.en: Group one gathers the avis family and a spelling trap; group two gathers homes of animals.
note.cn: 第一组收 avis 词族及拼写陷阱；第二组收动物居所的词。

entries.definition: a place for bees, from apis; one letter turns birds into insects.
entries.definitionCN: 养蜂场，出自 apis「蜂」；一字之差，鸟变虫。

entries.definition: flight and the aircraft industry, from the same avis.
entries.definitionCN: 航空；同出 avis 词根。

entries.definition: adjective, of or relating to birds.
a small barred container for one or a few birds.
entries.definitionCN: 小笼，装一只或少数几只鸟。
同款 -ary 场所词，住户换成蜂。

entries.definition: a collection of wild animals kept for exhibition.
entries.definitionCN: 展出用的异兽 collection；鸟舍可为其一角。

entries.definition: historically, buildings where hawks were kept while molting.
entries.definitionCN: 历史上换羽期圈养鹰隼的房舍。

normalIntro.en: Hang the word on avis, the Latin bird: an aviary is where avis lives.
normalIntro.cn: 把词挂在拉丁语 avis「鸟」上：aviary 就是 avis 住的地方。

normal.en: avis bird plus -ary place: like library from liber, book.
normal.cn: avis 鸟 + -ary 场所：正如 liber 书造出 library。

normal.en: Distinguish apiary, bees, from aviary, birds.
normal.cn: 区分 apiary（养蜂场）与 aviary（鸟舍）。

normal.en: Same family: aviation, aviator, avian all fly on avis.
normal.cn: 同族词 aviation、aviator、avian 都乘 avis 起飞。

normal.en: Plural spelling note: aviary becomes aviaries, y to ies.
normal.cn: 复数拼写：aviary 变 aviaries，y 变 ies。

normal.en: walk-through aviary is the modern zoo phrase.
normal.cn: walk-through aviary 是现代动物园的固定说法。

abstract.en: Look up: net instead of sky, yet still sky-colored light.
abstract.cn: 抬头看：网代替了天空，光线却仍是天光。

abstract.en: An aviary is a sky folded down to human size.
abstract.cn: 鸟舍是折叠到人间的天空。

abstract.en: Hear the whole room ticking with small claws and calls.
abstract.cn: 听整间屋子里小爪与鸣叫的窸窣。

examples.en: Volunteers repaired the storm-torn aviary before dawn.
examples.cn: 志愿者赶在天亮前修好了被风暴撕坏的鸟舍。

examples.en: The parrot slipped out of the aviary and colonized the park.
examples.cn: 那只鹦鹉溜出鸟舍，在公园里安了家。

examples.en: Her garden aviary held a dozen shimmering finches.
examples.cn: 她的花园鸟舍里养着十来只羽色闪亮的雀鸟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱喂鹅里」——爱喂鸟的鹅住的大笼子，就叫鸟舍

root: 出自拉丁语 aviarium「养鸟之所」，由 avis（鸟）+ 表场所后缀 -arium 构成；avis 词根可追溯至印欧语 awi-「鸟」。英语于 16 世纪后期借入，与 aviation、aviator、avian 同族；19 世纪起随动物园大型鸟舍扩展词义。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses scale the bird-house up and out: the home cage, the zoo hall, the breeding and quarantine sheds, the falconer's mews, and the figurative noisy room.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把「鸟屋」逐级放大：家用笼、动物园大馆、繁育与检疫棚、驯鹰房，以及比喻中喧闹的房间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: netting stretched where sky should be, birds flying inside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：在天空该在的地方绷起网，鸟在网内飞翔。

branches.en: THE KEEPING SIDE: from home shed to collection.
branches.cn: 饲养一面：从家庭小棚到收藏大笼。

branches.en: THE EXHIBIT SIDE: humans stepping into the birds' air.
branches.cn: 展出一面：人步入鸟的天空。

branches.en: THE OFFICIAL SIDE: breeding programs and quarantine lines.
branches.cn: 公务一面：繁育计划与检疫线。

branches.en: THE OLD SIDE: hawks housed for the hunt.
branches.cn: 古义一面：为狩猎而养的鹰房。

branches.en: THE FIGURATIVE SIDE: chatter and glassed-in rooms.
branches.cn: 比喻一面：聒噪人群与宅内鸟室。

intro.en: Aviary is avis plus -arium, one of Latin's most regular place-endings.
intro.cn: aviary 即 avis 加 -arium，后者是拉丁语最规整的场所后缀之一。

latinIntro.en: Latin -arium built names for where things live or are kept, from aquarium to armamentarium.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 -arium 为「存放、栖居之所」命名，从 aquarium 到 armamentarium 皆是。
